notes.text: Some off-peak trains terminate at Shanghai Railway Station; wait for the next train to Fujin Road.
On weekday peaks some trains terminate at Guanglan Road. For the airport, take a train signed Pudong Airport Terminal 1&2, or change at Guanglan Road.
On weekday peaks some westbound trains terminate at Songhong Road; take a train signed Panxiang Road, or change there.
